mapper.select: select t.id, MAX(t.work_no) AS work_no, MAX(t.order_id) AS order_id, MAX(t1.order_no) AS order_no, MAX(t.create_time) AS create_time, MAX(t.update_time) AS update_time, MAX(customer.id) AS userId, MAX(customer.customer_name) AS customerName, MAX(customer.phone) AS phone, MAX(t2.ecs_type) AS ecsTypeEnum, MAX(CASE WHEN t4.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isAllocatePublicIp, MAX(t2.ecs_scale) AS ecs_scale, MAX(t2.region) AS region, MAX(t2.zone_id) AS `zone`, MAX(t2.memory_size) AS memory_size, MAX(t2.cpu_model) AS cpu_model, MAX(t2.gpu_model) AS gpu_model, MAX(t2.gpu_memory) AS gpu_memory, MAX(t2.image_id) AS image_id, MAX(t2.expire_time) AS expire_time, MAX(t.number) AS quantity, MAX(CASE WHEN t1.order_status = 1 THEN t1.pay_time ELSE NULL END) AS payTime from sys_customer_ecs_work t left join sys_order t1 on t.order_id = t1.id left join sys_customer customer on t1.create_by_id = customer.id left join sys_customer_instances t2 on t1.id = t2.order_id left join sys_customer_ece_work_eip t4 on t4.ecs_work_id = t.id left join sys_customer_vpc t5 on customer.id = t5.customer_id where t.id = #{id} group by t.id
